sources.title: 2026 General Primary Certified Returns - Summary Totals (Statement of Votes Cast by Geography, 2026-06-09)
Official results export, used for holder names (results.pdf, generated 2026-06-09)

notes: Each precinct elects one Republican Committeeman and one Committeewoman (Vote for 1 each); 304 precincts. Filled = a ballot candidate won with more votes than all write-ins combined. Empty = no ballot candidate and zero write-in votes. Unknown = no ballot candidate but write-in votes were cast (136 seats). The certified report gives write-in totals only, and no 2026 write-in winners list was found on the county site. Three committeeman contest names in the source are misspelled ("UPPER SOUTHAMTPON TOWNSHIP WEST 1", "WARRINGTON TOWNSHIP DISTIRCT 4", "YARDLY BOROUGH") and were merged with the correctly spelled committeewoman contests. bucksvotes.gov did not respond to automated requests, so buckscounty.gov was used. Holder names come from the official results export: on each seat already counted as filled, the winning ballot candidate as printed (named write-ins are never used).
